issues.description: Keyboard focus is not contained by the open lightbox: after tabbing 32 times from opening, focus is not back on Close lightbox, so it escapes to the page behind (and/or thumbnail strip 'Jump to' items are divs not reachable by Tab).
issues.recommendation: Trap focus in the lightbox, make the thumbnails real buttons, and make the background inert.
